roundSummary: The implementer answered review round 1's two prose findings with comment edits in .github/workflows/ci.yaml (f51c9b08) and resolved both threads. I proved the edits are comments and nothing else — since the head whose green run carries this issue's measured time, the only product file changed is ci.yaml and all ten of its changed lines are comment lines — so the docs job's measured 1015.560 s still describes it, and I re-ran the router's own gate, ci-ok and the selection model at this head with a fresh negative control. CI at the new code head is green on everything settled, with four jobs still running at 22:06Z, read as running and not waited for. One defect, in the handoff ledger and not in the product: the implementer's round-4 proof entries cite a head SHA that is no commit.

implementerProof.how: All three entries of .legion/INFRA-756/implement.json's round-4 proof array check out on the surfaces they name, with one recorded error in their citation. (1) and (2), the two review threads: the pull request shows both threads answered and resolved, and the two comments now read exactly the wording the reviewer asked for — ci.yaml:2410-2416 ends 'It runs under -race because a read that walks a live document without its lock races the room's peers, which no ordinary run shows (TestReadsOfALiveDocumentRunBesideItsPeers, internal/dispatch/docs/live_read_race_test.go:39, LEGION-499)', and ci.yaml:2452-2454 reads 'go-envoy, restored only: its modules are the envoy module's, but this job builds the document service's race test binary, not the listener and natsd the family's saving jobs build, so it saves none.' The citation the second one rests on is right: the test is at live_read_race_test.go:39. (3) The gate: `PATH=/legion/scratch/tmp/yamlenv/bin:$PATH bash .github/scripts/check-ci-filters.sh` exits 0 at this head with `envoy-go-race-docs: 755 files, 0 uncovered`, `envoy-go-race: 2072 files, 0 uncovered` and `25 gates`, the same numbers as rounds 2 and 3. I did not take 'nothing else moved' from that alone: `jj diff --from 793974db91a6 --to f51c9b08cb05 --summary '~(.legion | docs/solutions)'` lists `.github/workflows/ci.yaml` and nothing else, and of the 10 added or removed lines in that diff, 0 are not comment lines — a machine check, not a reading. ci.yaml:2463-2464 and ci_job_reads.py:640-641 still carry `Race-test the document service` and `go test -race -timeout 60m ./internal/dispatch/docs/` identically, which is the pair an edit that strayed out of a comment would have broken. The error: both review-thread entries record `headSha: f51c9b08cb0575dd5a20dbdbd8d2a9ec3d4a3b20`, which names no commit — `gh api repos/sjawhar/legion/commits/f51c9b08cb0575dd5a20dbdbd8d2a9ec3d4a3b20` answers `422 No commit found for SHA`. The real commit is f51c9b08cb0500ecc4a13f9c3a669069368408df; only the first twelve hex digits are right. It is a defect in the evidence a reviewer and the merger resolve by SHA, not in the product, and `.legion/` is removed before the merge, so I record it here and name it to the implementer for its next commit on this branch rather than failing a round and spending a CI pass on it. Another phase's handoff is not mine to edit.
